current.text: Trae Young will start at point guard ahead of him.
He should not be handling point guard duties.
Washington added Trae Young, Anthony Davis and AJ Dybantsa.
The arrival of Young, Davis and Dybantsa cuts into the roles of Washington's young players.
The projected Washington starters are Trae Young, Kyshawn George, AJ Dybantsa, Anthony Davis and Alex Sarr. Carrington is not among them.
Washington has a crowded group of guards and wings, and many wings are competing for the fifth starter spot.
Washington is expected to use a 10 or 11 man rotation, with 12 or 13 players who could justify minutes.

durable.text: He ran point guard early in 2025-26, and it did not work out well.

note: He is not a draft target in our league. Yahoo ranks him 241 and ESPN 217, both value him at 0 USD, and only 144 players get drafted. ESPN projects 25.1 minutes behind Trae Young, and no category stands out: his assists and threes are only near the pool average, and he is weak in steals, points and FG%. Leave him on waivers and check early in the season whether an injury to Young or one of the wings gives him more minutes.
